nodes.description: Owner address state variable in Owned contract, set to msg.sender at deployment and reassigned on acceptOwnership.
Pending new owner address used by transferOwnership/acceptOwnership two-step ownership handover.
Public token symbol, set to BUXCM in the constructor.
Public token name, set to BUX COIN MONEY in the constructor.
Public token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply minted to the deployer-specified address during construction.
Mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping owner => spender => allowance, written by approve and approveAndCall and decremented by transferFrom.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits, allowance keys and forwarded into external calls.
SafeMath addition with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath subtraction with require(b <= a) underflow guard.
SafeMath multiplication with division-based overflow guard.
SafeMath division with require(b > 0) guard.
Owned constructor assigning owner from msg.sender.
onlyOwner function writing the pending newOwner address.
Second step of ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner and reassigns owner.
Token constructor initializing metadata, supply and pre-allocated balance plus Transfer event.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using unchecked arithmetic.
Returns the stored balance for the queried token owner.
Debits msg.sender and credits the recipient using SafeMath, then emits Transfer.
Overwrites the allowed allowance for a spender from msg.sender and emits Approval.
Moves tokens between accounts using the caller allowance, guarded by SafeMath.
Returns the remaining allowance approved by tokenOwner for spender.
Sets allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract in the same transaction.
Payable fallback that immediately reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract address.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] that can underflow if the zero address ever holds a balance.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-supplied contract with no return-value check.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an untrusted contract; return value unchecked.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner directly from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before reassigning ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-supplied address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key in the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall keys the allowance on msg.sender and forwards it to the callback.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted to the owner via msg.sender check.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument into the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stores the candidate into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the authorization check and event.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Constructor mints and stores the total supply.
Constructor credits the full supply to a hard-coded balance entry.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] for the burn-address adjustment.
_totalSupply - balances[address(0)] is performed without an underflow guard.
balanceOf reads from the balances mapping.
balanceOf indexes the mapping with the caller-supplied tokenOwner parameter.
balanceOf returns the local balance variable.
transfer reads and writes balance entries for sender and recipient.
transfer debits the sender through the guarded safeSub subtraction.
transfer credits the recipient through the guarded safeAdd addition.
transfer credits the to parameter.
transfer uses the tokens parameter as the movement amount.
approve writes the allowed nested mapping.
approve keys the allowance by the spender parameter.
approve writes the tokens parameter as the allowance value.
transferFrom mutates both the from and to balance entries.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses guarded safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses guarded safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transferFrom debits the from parameter account.
transferFrom credits the to parameter account.
transferFrom uses the tokens parameter as the movement amount.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
allowance keys the mapping by tokenOwner parameter.
allowance keys the mapping by spender parameter.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external callback.
approveAndCall transfers control to the untrusted spender contract via receiveApproval.
approveAndCall uses the spender parameter as allowance key and callback target.
approveAndCall uses the tokens parameter for allowance and callback amount.
approveAndCall forwards the arbitrary data parameter to the callback contract.
transferAnyERC20Token delegates execution to an arbitrary external token contract.
transferAnyERC20Token uses the tokenAddress parameter as the external call target.
transferAnyERC20Token uses the tokens parameter as the rescued amount.
The rescue call sends tokens to the privileged owner address.
safeAdd operates on the caller-supplied first addend.
safeAdd operates on the caller-supplied second addend.
safeAdd stores and returns the guarded sum in local variable c.
safeSub stores and returns the guarded difference in local variable c.
safeMul stores and returns the guarded product in local variable c.
safeDiv stores and returns the guarded quotient in local variable c.

Recipient argument of transfer; its only effect is the balance write performed by transfer.
Amount argument of transfer; merged into the transfer balance-update semantics.
Spender argument of approve; merged into the allowance write of approve.
Allowance argument of approve; merged into the allowance write of approve.
Debited account argument of transferFrom; merged into its balance mutation.
Credited account argument of transferFrom; merged into its balance mutation.
Moved amount argument of transferFrom; merged into its balance and allowance updates.
Callback target argument; merged into the approveAndCall external-call behaviour.
Allowance and callback amount argument; merged into approveAndCall.
